summary: MINISO Group Holding Limited filed a routine Form 6-K attaching eight Next Day Disclosure Returns (the Hong Kong equivalent of an issuer share buyback/change-in-issued-shares notice) dated October 26-29, 2026. The disclosures report a flat issued-share count of 1,214,041,449 and a single repurchase of 100,000 ordinary shares (0.0082%) for cancellation at HKD 19.7195 per share on October 26, 2026. No corporate transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal structure is involved; this is ordinary on-market buyback administration with no special-situation event. Watch only for cumulative buyback pace and cancellation cadence.
